download_single_file_checkpoint: download a single file checkpoint from a Hugging Face Hub repo to a local temp directory
download_original_config: download an original config YAML file from a URL and save it to a local temp directory
download_diffusers_config: download diffusers config JSON and text files from a Hugging Face Hub repo excluding weight files
test_single_file_model_config: test that a model loaded from a single file checkpoint matches the pretrained model config
test_single_file_format_inference_is_sam: test that inference output from a single file loaded pipeline matches the pretrained pipeline output
